divisions.title: First Lament
divisions.summary: Jerusalem personified weeps over her desolation and asks if any sorrow matches hers.

divisions.title: Second Lament
divisions.theme: The Lord has swallowed up without mercy
divisions.summary: God's anger described in vivid detail as elders sit silent in the dust.

divisions.title: Third Lament
divisions.theme: His mercies never come to an end
divisions.summary: The man who has seen affliction finds hope in God's steadfast love and faithfulness.

divisions.title: Fourth Lament
divisions.summary: Precious sons of Zion now valued as clay pots, their beauty and nobility gone.

divisions.title: Fifth Lament
divisions.theme: But you, O LORD, reign forever
divisions.summary: A final plea asking God to remember and restore his people from their shame.

2.title: Lord has swallowed up without mercy

3.title: I am the man who has seen affliction
His mercies never come to an end
Let us test and examine our ways
I called on your name O Lord

4.title: Lord gave full vent to his wrath
Our pursuers were swifter than eagles

5.title: Remember O Lord what has befallen us
But you O Lord reign forever
